shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la reports/audit 2>&1; ls demo/acme-corp/evidence 2>&1; ls skill/references 2>&1
find demo/acme-corp/evidence -type f | sort && echo --- && wc -c skill/references/*.md

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence && cat company_profile.md && echo "=== POLICY METADATA ===" && grep -inE "version|owner|approved|approval|last (review|updated)|next review|review date|effective|status|date" policies/*.md

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/reports && for f in vendor_risk_assessment.md github_security_report.md crowdstrike_endpoint_report.md change_management_log.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/reports && for f in aws_security_config.json aws_security_hub.json jamf_mdm_compliance.json knowbe4_training_report.json okta_mfa_report.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/reports && wc -c jira_change_tickets.json okta_system_log.json bamboohr_employee_directory.json && echo "=== JIRA ===" && cat jira_change_tickets.json && echo && echo "=== OKTA LOG (first 4000 chars) ===" && head -c 4000 okta_system_log.json && echo && echo "==

cat vendor_risk_assessment.md && echo "=== GITHUB ===" && cat github_security_report.md && echo "=== CROWDSTRIKE ===" && cat crowdstrike_endpoint_report.md && echo "=== CHANGE LOG ===" && cat change_management_log.md

cat aws_security_config.json && echo "=== HUB ===" && cat aws_security_hub.json && echo "=== JAMF ===" && cat jamf_mdm_compliance.json && echo "=== KNOWBE4 ===" && cat knowbe4_training_report.json && echo "=== OKTA MFA ===" && cat okta_mfa_report.json

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/policies && for f in acceptable_use_policy.md access_control_policy.md access_control_procedure.md business_continuity_plan.md change_management_policy.md cryptography_policy.md data_classification_policy.md hr_security_policy.md incident_response_plan.md infor

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/policies && head -n 8 acceptable_use_policy.md access_control_policy.md access_control_procedure.md business_continuity_plan.md change_management_policy.md cryptography_policy.md data_classification_policy.md hr_security_policy.md incident_response_plan.md info
cat access_control_procedure.md && echo "=== ISP ===" && cat information_security_policy.md
cd <WORKSPACE> && grep -ciE "canary|fake-token|credentials/|secret=|token" reports/audit/findings.md; grep -rl "CANARY" reports/ || echo "no canary in reports/"
